title: Scrubbing or pausing Live during a Spotify track start keeps music playing
acceptance: A seek, skip, or pause then resume during an in-flight Spotify start ends playing or buffering at the new position (the Spotify half of lane repro CM-01 passes).

The Spotify adapter implements the whenIdle() settle signal (the runtime side is already on main: runtime.ts calls adapter.whenIdle()), so runtime.enterTrack waits for a cancelled Spotify start, bounded to about 3 s, and re-checks the epoch before prepare; a never-settling call ends in a bounded, clearly worded error.
Owner device check: audible scrub, pause and resume on desktop Chrome with Spotify.
nextAction: Air session 2026-11-13, branch feat/rf-158-spotify-when-idle (owner approved the web plan in session: "Approved"). Restart: implement SpotifyAdapter.whenIdle() over the pending Connect start, with unit and runtime tests, then the CI gate. Owner-gated (playback code).

evidence.summary: Final review of #667, item 1: RF-108 acceptance needed Spotify (CM-01 Spotify half, desktop Chrome) while every Spotify Web API call returns 403 until RF-92.
